obstacle.reason: Deletion is the right gesture here: the false edge has to go. What is missing is what tells it from the true one when no constraint separates them. Measured: with a weight carried from the document, a repairer goes from 65 of 130 — a coin — to 130 of 130, stable on three runs.
obstacle.reason_fr: La suppression est ici le bon geste : la fausse arête doit partir. Ce qui manque, c'est de quoi la distinguer de la vraie quand aucune contrainte ne les sépare. Mesuré : avec un poids porté depuis le document, un réparateur passe de 65 sur 130 — une pièce — à 130 sur 130, stable.

era.note: one of the fourteen difficulties born with the modern era; it had no line in the catalogue before 2026-08-08. Discipline reserve, measured the same day: on 14 articles of physics, mathematics, computer science, economics and linguistics, zero structured abstract, zero pre-registration and zero ethics declaration. This form is biomedical before it is modern, and a corpus that takes it as a generic property of the modern article measures a discipline, not a form.
